vb_textbox.text: I would pay close attention to how the colours fluctuate. say the brown hat for example, get into the pattern of recognising how it goes from 2 mushrooms to 6 then to 20 sometimes, then it will start going down. Its fine to keep trying that brown one but as soon as it hits 0 mushrooms I tended to switch.What's good though is that the colours were grouped so it was easier to remember, like Brown/orange - red/pink - blue/purple - yellow/green. if these were random I would have struggled more, however, I found it easy keeping track of what was doing well. I found it helpful saying the colour out loud of a high scoring one to reinforce it in my mind. when colours went up or down I would say "green in" and when green started to score low I would say "yellow in" as it was the opposite
